d: Dipavli ke pavan avsar par samucha desh roshni se jagamga utha. gharon aur pratishthanon men dip jalae gae aur aatishbaji ke bich logon ne prakash parv manaya. dipotsav ke jarie andhkar par prakash aur adharm par dharm ki jit ka sandesh diya gaya. vahin, pradhanmantri narendr modi ne chhattisgarh ke bastar men suraksha balon ke javanon ko mithaee khilakar dipavli ki shubhkamnaen din. is dauran unhonne deshvasiyon ko dimagi naksalvad ke prati satark karte hue vikas karyon ko lekar sarkar ki pratibaddhata jataee aur kshetr men ho rahe vikas ko rangoli ke rup men prastut uplabdhiyon se jora.…
